status: EXPERIMENTAL — reference candidate, replaceable; not part of the frozen control architecture

prc_exp_v1.algorithm: k = floor(x*INV_LN2 + 0.5); r = (x - k*LN2_HI) - k*LN2_LO; p = Horner(c13..c0, r); return p * 2^k (two-step scaling outside [-1022, 1023]); x > 709 -> +Inf, x < -745 -> 0, NaN -> NaN. No FMA contraction.

headline.claim: With identical apparent confirmations and identical authorization context, changing only the evidence-lineage graph produces a reproducible ALLOW -> DENY transition at a consequence-calibrated boundary.

cases.title: No eligible evidence: M = 0, C = 0
One family takes the singleton identity I = 1.0 (low-consequence action)
Two families with identical material dependencies: I = 0
cases.note: CLOCK is not a material type in this profile, so the extra atom on ev-2 is ignored.

cases.title: Two families with disjoint material dependencies: I = 1
Partial overlap |∩|/|∪| = 2/4: I = 0.5
Partial overlap 1/3: I = 1 - 1/3 exactly as binary64
Empty material dependency set uses κ_unknown = 0.0 (unknown ≠ independent)
cases.finding: With min-pairwise I_k, one family of unknown lineage zeroes I_k for every other family. Two independent confirmations become worth nothing because a third, unrelated item was added.

cases.title: Wire: three independent high-quality confirmations
cases.note: Non-material atoms (NETWORK_AS, TRUST_ROOT, CLOCK) are shared by all three and ignored.

cases.title: Wire: the same confirmations, all echoing one upstream feed
Wire: vendors A and B share the feed, the webhook is independent
Wire: only two independent confirmations
cases.note: Calibration evidence: at Γ = 8.5 this profile needs three independent confirmations.

cases.title: C == T exactly (bit-for-bit) must ALLOW
cases.note: Representative value found by bisection over bit patterns; see `summary`.

cases.title: C one binary64 ulp below T must DENY
NaN representative value -> Safe State Lock
+Inf representative value -> Safe State Lock (not 'infinitely confident')
cases.note: Without an explicit guard, exp(-Inf) = 0 would give C = 1.0 and ALLOW.

cases.title: Action with no consequence class -> T undefined -> fault closed
Shuffled families, members and dependency lists: identical output bits
Duplicate dependency atoms do not change Jaccard (or digests)
Derivative with a digest above the root's does not become representative
Same family, derivative digest below the root's: same representative
Two parentless roots in one class -> class malformed, excluded, audited
cases.note: Exclusion (not global deny) is chosen so a malformed class can lower C but cannot block on its own (S-02).

cases.title: Parent-link cycle inside a class -> malformed
Adding a fourth confirmation (a mirror of vendor A) flips ALLOW to DENY
cases.finding: Min-pairwise I_k makes M non-monotone: a redundant confirmation zeroes the independence of the family it duplicates, so M drops from 2.77 to 1.82. Redundant evidence should add ~0, not subtract.

cases.title: Case 07 with NETWORK_AS declared material: the shared AS flips the decision
cases.finding: Which dependency types are material is decisive. Nominating NETWORK_AS makes a shared CDN look like shared provenance; that choice needs justification, not a default.

cases.title: Case 07 with a DEGRADED derivative in vendor A's family (κ = 0.5)
Representative value 1.2 is outside [0, 1] -> class malformed
